fusions.name: Quarry's End
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 20 damage to a target at or below 30% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Quarry Glint
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Closing Leap
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
